journal: J. Chem. Eng. Data 30 (1), 44-49 (data on pp. 46-47)
title: Densities of Aqueous Solutions of NaCl, MgCl2, KCl, NaBr, LiCl, and CaCl2 from 0.05 to 5.0 mol kg-1 and 0.1013 to 40 MPa at 298.15 K
authors: Jeffrey A. Gates, Robert H. Wood
needs_pass2_reason: text layer (original PDF text, positions via bbox) was clean; rows were assembled by script from word coordinates and every block was compared with the page images of pp. 46 and 47; no cell needed correction
experimental_method: Vibrating-tube densimeter (Albert design) measuring density difference between solution and water by injecting a 6-mL sample into a water stream; calibrated with water and nitrogen; 298.15 K, 0.1013-40 MPa
uncertainties_stated: concentration to 0.1 % (0.2 % for 2.952 mol/kg MgCl2), giving 0.1 % in Delta rho; pressure about 0.3 MPa (max 30 ppm in Delta rho); temperature constant to better than 0.001 K; replicate runs agree to better than 20 ppm (95 % limits about 40 ppm); fit standard errors about 50 ppm
quality_remarks: PDF starts with the end of another article (Singh & Sinha, p. 44, table/references of binary/ternary liquid mixtures) and ends with a short article (enthalpy of mixing, p. 49-50).
NaBr block, 40 MPa group, third row: molality printed 0.013 where the sequence 4.972, 3.013, 2.006, 1.004 shows 3.013 is meant (Delta rho 211.360, consistent with 3.013); kept as printed.
MgCl2 at about 31 MPa lacks the 2.262 mol/kg row; CaCl2 at about 40 MPa lacks the 0.5026 mol/kg row (as printed).
Several rows have Delta residuals of 100 ppm or more (e.g. NaCl 4.991 mol/kg at 17.13 MPa, 117); authors comment that the calculated density for 5.0 mol/kg NaCl is 600 ppm low at 40 MPa.
Temperature scale not stated; 298.15 K given in the title.

not_extracted_tables.reason: coefficients of the authors' empirical fit (model parameters)

row_counts.table_1: printed 228 data rows in 6 blocks (NaCl 40, MgCl2 34, KCl 35, NaBr 40, LiCl 40, CaCl2 39); written 228 plus 6 label rows

extraction_notes: value is the density difference Delta rho (printed x 10^3, scale 0.001); phi_v is derived by the authors. Pressure varies per row (nominal 0.1013, 10.38, 17.13, about 31, about 40 MPa).
pass2_diff: Table I: 228 rows, 1368/1368 numbers identical; NaBr molality 0.013 printed so in both passes.
